lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-linear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity serve as structural axes, with high-intensity blobs located precisely at the intersections of these vertical bands and faint horizontal planes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear feature extending horizontally across the dorsal-lateral region, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal aspect to shadowed, low-luminance pixels on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch exhibiting loss of typical pigmentation patterns is located immediately anterior to the first gill slit, suggesting significant cutaneous trauma or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of significantly smaller, uniform high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more sparse constellation on the lateral flank.
